## ⚡ Improved

- **`latest` follows releases.** `latest` is always the newest release, so an unreleased change no longer reaches you as an update. The tip of development is published as `edge`.
- **The published image gets the base system's updates every week,** between releases too.
- **A compose file for Docker Compose.** `compose.yaml` sets up Euro Office with the same ports, folders and settings as the Unraid template. Fill in `JWT_SECRET` before the first start.

## 🐛 Fixed

- **Euro Office starts on Proxmox VE.** When Proxmox creates a container from the image, it removes the image's private keys, as it does with the SSH host keys of a template. That took the key the bundled PostgreSQL uses with it, so PostgreSQL stopped at `could not access private key file "/etc/ssl/private/ssl-cert-snakeoil.key"` and the editor never came up. The container creates a new key when it is missing.

## Updating an existing install

Nothing to change, **Force Update** is enough.
